narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Exposition -> Problem Analysis -> Reaction -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to discuss the recent technical issues and community reactions surrounding the game 'Artale' (MapleStory Worlds). Two hosts analyze the failure of the game's auction house system and how players have adapted through unofficial trading and party systems, eventually critiquing the developers for forcing players to spend money on megaphones due to these system failures.
